steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Diep Linh, a wood element leaf sprite, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: floating down over the food; (3) EAT: its leaf hair wrapping around the food; (4) EAT: glowing green while absorbing it. Row 2: (5) EAT: twirling happily with sparkles; (6) PLAY: gathering wind, leaves swirling around it; (7) PLAY: floating upward; (8) PLAY: riding a big leaf like a surfboard. Row 3: (9) PLAY: twirling in a whirlwind of leaves; (10) PLAY: gliding down gently; (11) PLAY: arms open, petals raining around it; (12) REFUSE food: hiding behind a leaf like a shield. Row 4: (13) PETTED: blushing leaves, eyes closed; (14) WAVE hello: waving with a leaf hand; (15) SAD: curled up, leaf hair drooping; (16) ANGRY: leaves turning sharp and pointy.
